_comment: Native Zingtree dynamic single-select field for the joint-accounts Content node. Add this object to that node's formfields array. Field shape (label_type, config-as-stringified-JSON, required) copied from a proven org export (ETG Rebooking Multi-Tree). Options come from transforms.joint_account_options staged by experian-joint-accounts-build-options.js (run that script on the node BEFORE this Content node). required:"1" makes Zingtree block Continue until the agent picks one - which is the whole point of going native. filterable adds type-ahead; drop it if the list is short.
name: joint_account_choice
label: Which joint account applies?
